51193.summary: The class discusses the gathering of nations in Revelation 16 and Joel 3, emphasizing the divine judgment against those who have oppressed Israel. It connects this to Ezekiel 38 and the geopolitical situation involving Israel, Russia, and the EU, highlighting signs of the times and the impending return of Christ.

51194.summary: The class discusses the significance of the 'Day of Yahweh' in Revelation, emphasizing the responsibility of the Ecclesia to proclaim the truth and invite others to seek the water of life. It also explores the themes of judgment, the return of Christ, and the importance of being watchful and prepared for His coming.
